name: Order Product Picking For WooCommerce
author: Atakan Au

sections.description:
Order Product Picking For WooCommerce simplifies order fulfillment in your WooCommerce store. It enables warehouse staff to pick orders accurately and manage inventory seamlessly. Ideal for small and large stores, this plugin optimizes the picking process.

Key Features:
– Order Selection: Easily select orders to start picking via a user-friendly interface.
– Inventory Tracking: Update picked quantities in real-time to prevent over-picking.
– User Permissions: Restrict access to administrators and shop managers by default.
– Responsive Design: Mobile-friendly tables and interface.
– Multilingual Support: Translation-ready for global use.
– PRO Feature: Barcode scanning for orders and products (available in PRO version).

Learn more at the Order Product Picking For WooCommerce Blog Page.

Support and Feedback

Have questions or suggestions? Visit support page. Your feedback helps improve!
sections.installation:
1. Upload order-product-picking-for-woocommerce.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or use the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the [oppckngfw_picking_ui_lite] shortcode to a page to enable the order picking interface.
sections.faq:
Which WooCommerce versions is this plugin compatible with?

Compatible with WordPress 5.0+ and WooCommerce 4.0.1+. Tested up to WooCommerce 10.0.4.

Which user roles can access the plugin?

By default, administrators and shop managers. Custom users can be set via shortcode in the PRO version.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, it’s translation-ready with support for custom translation files in the languages folder.

Can I use it without barcode values?

No, barcode query is a PRO version feature.

How do I enable barcode scanning?

Barcode scanning is available in the PRO version. Upgrade at programs.com.tr.
